library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph bottleneck {
  graph [
    rankdir = LR
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    bgcolor = 'transparent'
    nodesep = 0.6
    ranksep = 0.8
    size = '10,1.2!'
    ratio = 'fill'
  ]

  node [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    style = 'filled,rounded'
    fontcolor = 'white'
    penwidth = 0
    shape = box
  ]

  edge [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 11
    color = '#666666'
    arrowsize = 0.9
  ]

  input [
    label = 'Sensorischer Input\\n\\nUmwelt'
    fillcolor = '#94a3b8'
    fontsize = 13
    fontcolor = '#222222'
    margin = '0.3,0.2'
    width = 2
  ]

  wm [
    label = 'Arbeitsgedächtnis\\n\\n~4 Elemente\\n15–30 Sekunden\\nAktives Lernen'
    fillcolor = '#E69F00'
    fontsize = 13
    fontcolor = '#222222'
    margin = '0.3,0.2'
    width = 2.5
  ]

  ltm [
    label = 'Langzeitgedächtnis\\n\\nUnbegrenzte Kapazität\\nDauerhaft\\nOrganisiert in Schemata'
    fillcolor = '#0072B2'
    fontsize = 13
    margin = '0.3,0.2'
    width = 2.8
  ]

  input -> wm [label = '  Aufmerksamkeit  ']
  wm -> ltm [label = '  Schemabildung\\n  & Übung  ']
  ltm -> wm [label = '  Abruf &\\n  Aktivierung  ' style = dashed]
}
")
